Never be afraid to experiment with new exciting and exotic fruits.

Pineapple is a bromeliad and can be grown in the house in a pot. It likes well drained soil in full sun. You can toss them outside if you live in a winter free climate. They enjoy lots of water but can also tolerate more arid conditions.

To get one going, you simply cut off the top of a pineapple, it needs to have a bit of fruit still attached. Sit in in some shallow water till small roots sprout then stick it in some dirt up to the base of the leaves. You can also plant it directly after cutting but they will grow a bit faster with a few roots. They can take a year or two to produce fruit but in the mean time you'll have an interesting spikey plant to add character to your plots and planters.
